description: This file implements the server-side logic for the login page in an ASP.NET Core web application using Razor Pages. It manages user authentication, handles login form submissions, external authentication schemes, and transfers anonymous shopping baskets upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginModel
classes.description: PageModel class for handling user login operations, including credential validation, external login schemes, and basket transfer on login success.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initialize the login page, clear external cookies, and list available external login schemes.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests for user login, manages sign-in attempts, and navigates based on login result.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketToUserAsync
methods.description: Transfers an anonymous user's basket to their account after successful login, deleting the anonymous basket cookie.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Initializes login page, manages external authentication schemes, cleans cookies.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Attempts user sign-in with provided credentials, handles success and failure, and manages two-factor and lockout scenarios.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketToUserAsync
methods.description: Transfers basket associated with anonymous session to the authenticated user.
